audit.why: Vex is a hard early counter (56.67% WR over 4362 games) and Yasuo flips it at crit items — content chart and packet agree; full chart said Skill everywhere.
audit.corrected: Full chart flipped to match (see edits).

audit.why: Spikes: 3-5 anti-dash window, 6 best kill window, first crit item flip, late outscale. Correct and specific.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claimed Vex W 'cleanses his slow' — Personal Space is a shield plus damage pulse, it cleanses nothing. Missing interaction: Way of the Wanderer's moving shield absorbing the burst window. Wind Wall numbers absent (25s rank 1, 4s duration).
audit.why: Kit: Vex W = shield + damage only; Yasuo P shield-flagged; W 25/23/21/19/17, blocks projectiles 4s; R 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Fixed the cleanse claim, added the passive-shield poke-off note, and put real Wind Wall/R numbers in cooldowns.
Wind Wall 25-17s / 4s duration, his R 30s at rank 3, own W 16s, R 140s.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: Mark and bolt — his passive shield charges as he moves, so poke it off first: real burst must land on a shieldless Yasuo.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Personal Space has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining, 25s at rank 1 falling to 17 and blocking for only 4s — hold Q and R until it is spent. - His R drops to 30s at rank 3: any knockup near you is lethal. - Your W (16s) is for the moment it goes wrong; the R (140s) for when it goes right.

edits.before: You are the engage tax: their dive comp feeds your fears, your R feeds on their commitments, and the carry they sent dies mid-dash, repeatedly.
edits.after: Late Yasuo out-duels you: never side-lane into him, group so he cannot wall everything, fear the flank, and R whoever he dives onto.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 and blocks Q and R for 4 seconds — bait it with a short E feint, then throw the real bolt through the gap.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Shadow Surge is an execute — cast it while your fear's burst window is open; held past the wall's 4 seconds, the kill walks away.

edits.before: You're a textbook anti-Yasuo pick early: every time he E-dashes through minions your Gloom passive auto-arms, and a charged Q interrupts his dash and chunks him. Hold E Looming Darkness to fear him out of his engage, and W to cleanse his slow and burst back. Respect his Wind Wall (W) — bait it with an E feint before you throw the real Q or R.
